data.narrative:
Havoc AI is a Series A-stage frontier-tech company operating in the Ocean & Maritime sector. The company has raised $200M to date. The comparable universe consists of two private peers—Seasats and Bedrock Ocean—with no public comps available in this nascent segment.

Valuation analysis relies on a stage-progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($200M) as a baseline proxy, a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $400M. This single-method result anchors the analysis.

The triangulated range spans $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $400M. The compressed range reflects limited methodological diversity—reliance on a single stage-progression approach rather than revenue multiples, comparable company analysis, or DCF. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier for ocean-tech specifically, the relevance of only two private comparables, and absence of public market reference points. Revenue, unit economics, and market size data would strengthen conviction in this valuation band. Until additional private or public transaction data emerges in this sector, the $400M median should be treated as illustrative rather than definitive.
